verdict.rationale: Check is an embedded payroll API, so having hourly time and overtime flow into a payroll run is a fair question for it. The evidence documents creating, previewing and approving payroll objects, but nothing about hourly time entries, hours worked, overtime calculation, or time-tracking data feeding a payroll run. Generic payroll creation does not establish this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have hourly time entries and overtime flow directly into the payroll run
